# cc-web

Web control plane for Claude coding agents. The architecture you must respect
is `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`; run checks with `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`,
`bun run lint`.

## shadcn-vue generated files — never edit

**Không bao giờ sửa / lint / format các file sinh ra của shadcn-vue.**

These paths are generated by the shadcn-vue CLI and are never hand-edited,
reformatted, or lint-fixed — Biome skips them by override in `biome.json`:

- `apps/web/src/components/ui/**`
- `apps/web/src/lib/utils.ts`
- `apps/web/src/styles/index.css`
- `apps/web/components.json`

To change what they produce, run the shadcn-vue CLI (`add`/`diff`) or override
at the call site: extra classes, a wrapper element, or theme variables. The
cc-web palette is mapped onto shadcn's semantic variables in
`apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css` — that file is ours to edit; the generated
`index.css` is not.
